Title: Confirm repository conventions and local developer workflow
Acceptance Criteria: Clean checkout instructions; config validated; format/lint/test commands discoverable

Title: Establish application skeleton and module boundaries
Acceptance Criteria: App starts locally; modular boundaries explicit; no cross-module repository bypass

Title: Add structured logging and request correlation
Acceptance Criteria: Correlation IDs in logs; secrets and sensitive payloads redacted

Title: Add health and readiness endpoints
Acceptance Criteria: Liveness/readiness distinct and tested

Title: Configure database migrations and test database workflow
Acceptance Criteria: Migrations apply to empty DB; integration tests isolated

Title: Add CI checks and automated test stages
Acceptance Criteria: CI runs formatting/lint, unit and relevant integration/contract tests, dependency/static checks, and simple architecture-boundary checks; a deliberate failing check fails CI

Title: Define minimal Problem Pack schema and validation rules
Acceptance Criteria: Candidate-visible and private content classes separated; version metadata validated

Title: Create one reviewed seed Problem Pack
Acceptance Criteria: Pack passes structural validation and human correctness review; provenance recorded

Title: Implement published Problem Pack retrieval and version pinning
Acceptance Criteria: Session pins immutable version; candidate API excludes private fields

Title: Implement session state transition guards
Acceptance Criteria: Allowed/forbidden transitions tested; arbitrary state setting rejected

Title: Implement session snapshot and event persistence
Acceptance Criteria: Snapshot/event atomic; version checks prevent lost updates

Title: Add session ownership and authorization checks
Acceptance Criteria: Cross-user read/write tests fail safely; Clerk token verification and provider-subject-to-internal-user mapping work; development/test identity adapter is prohibited in production.

Title: Add idempotency and optimistic concurrency to session commands
Acceptance Criteria: Duplicate commands safe; stale versions rejected

Title: Implement first session API endpoints
Acceptance Criteria: Create/get session and submit action conform to OpenAPI contract

Title: Add deterministic stub interviewer for vertical slice
Acceptance Criteria: Stage-appropriate prompt; no authority over state transitions

Title: Verify first end-to-end session flow and resume
Acceptance Criteria: Open/start/respond/advance/reload works; invalid transitions and retries tested

Title: Add Model Gateway skeleton and structured output validation
Acceptance Criteria: OpenAI adapter is isolated; model map is centrally configured (gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-luna, conditional gpt-6-astra, gpt-transcribe, gpt-4o-mini-tts); fake adapter tests timeout, bounded retry, schema validation, usage; integration follows session contract.

Title: Implement LLM interaction policy and regression fixtures
Acceptance Criteria: State policy cannot be bypassed; ambiguity/abstention/invalid output tested

Title: Implement approach assessment and ordered hint policy
Acceptance Criteria: Reviewed Problem Pack reference approaches and hints are available; low confidence abstains/clarifies; one hint per action; exposure recorded

Title: Threat-model and prototype isolated execution worker
Acceptance Criteria: Threat model and isolation proof of concept verify selected E2B managed sandbox, provider data-processing/region, network/secret restrictions, toolchain feasibility, resource limits and cleanup before exposure.

Title: Implement execution coordinator and bounded queue
Acceptance Criteria: Amazon SQS Standard + DLQ; at-least-once/out-of-order delivery handled idempotently; bounded concurrency (initial target 10 executions), visibility timeout, retry/redrive, cancellation and infrastructure-error classification work.

Title: Integrate submissions with sessions and trusted test evaluation
Acceptance Criteria: Hidden expected outputs remain outside sandbox; result versioned

Title: Generate evidence-backed feedback report
Acceptance Criteria: Evidence links and pack/rubric/model versions retained

Title: Implement content review and immutable publishing workflow
Acceptance Criteria: Unreviewed packs cannot publish; published versions immutable

Title: Add curated follow-up and variant selection
Acceptance Criteria: Reviewed follow-ups/variants selected and recorded

Title: Validate observability, capacity, backup restore, and rollback
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboards, load tests, restore and rollback demonstrated; all in-scope V1 modes have release evidence

Title: Record V1 voice scope decision and update product/architecture contracts
Acceptance Criteria: Owner selected turn-based voice input/transcription, visible transcript, interviewer speech output, explicit consent and text fallback; PRD/ADRs/feature order/API/voice contract updated. Implementation is tracked separately in K-029.

Title: Establish environment configuration and secret-handling baseline
Acceptance Criteria: Separate dev/staging/prod configuration; validate required settings; document secret injection/storage; no real secrets in tracked files or logs

Title: Implement V1 turn-based voice input/transcription and speech output
Acceptance Criteria: Implement versioned consent/revocation; bounded audio validation; OpenAI gpt-transcribe via Model Gateway; transcript enters same state machine as typed input; display interviewer text and stream gpt-4o-mini-tts speech on demand; no durable raw audio/speech storage; failures preserve state; text fallback, rate limits, log redaction and retention tests pass.
